youtube_short.title: Waiting 10 Years to Invest Costs $418,000
title_alternatives: Start Investing at 25 vs 35: The Real Gap
youtube_short.description: Same $300 a month. Same 7% return. Start at 35 instead of 25 and you end up with $418,000 less at retirement — and it's not even the missed contributions, it's compound interest on the compound interest. The best time to start was yesterday. The second best is right now. Even $50 a month today is better than waiting for the 'perfect' moment that never comes. #personalfinance #investing #compoundinterest #money
